classification.difficultyReason: Separate overlapping angles by taking the complement of a reflex sector and combining the remaining sectors.

content.prompt: Find the value of $e$. Notice that $309^\circ$ and $48^\circ$ are overlapping.

spec.description: Vertical line through a marked vertex with two rightward arms. Concentric unfilled arcs distinguish the reflex 309-degree region, the unknown sector and the overlapping 48-degree sector.
spec.mathematics: The upper-right arm has direction 9 degrees and the lower-right arm direction -42 degrees. Their complement is the 309-degree reflex angle. The lower-right arm is 48 degrees from the downward vertical.
spec.answerVisibility: Only e°, 309° and 48° are visible; 81 and the completed answer are excluded.

answer.worked:
Angles on a straight line give the angle between the upward vertical and upper-right arm:
$$\begin{align*}309-180-48&=81.\end{align*}$$
Using the right-hand straight angle:
$$\begin{align*}e+48+81&=180\\e&=180-48-81\\e&=51.\end{align*}$$
Therefore $e=51^\circ$.
